title: automate-kms-tls-rotation-and-sealed-secrets-for-private-installer
author: Priya Nair
release_notes: Automates TLS certificate rotation and KMS key rotation for private installer; integrates HashiCorp Vault and sealed-secrets workflow; adds Helm hooks and Terraform module for KMS/HSM binding. Backwards compatible; operator guidance added to docs.
description: Adds automated TLS certificate rotation and KMS key rotation support to the private installer. This PR integrates HashiCorp Vault (transit + PKI) and Sealed Secrets controller for safely provisioning rotated certs to on-prem clusters, provides a Terraform module to provision KMS bindings and HSM configuration, updates Helm charts with pre/post upgrade hooks to handle key/cert rollout and rollback, and introduces an operator-friendly CLI script for emergency rotation and dry-run mode. Motivation: customers running Private in regulated environments require automated, auditable rotation for TLS certs and KMS/HSM key material without manual cluster access. Changes are implemented to be backward-compatible: existing installations without Vault will continue to work, and an explicit opt-in flag enables automated rotation. Includes end-to-end integration tests and CI jobs that run against a Vault dev instance for verification.
commits: a1b2c3f: feat(kms): add terraform module for kms/hsm bindings and policy templates
d4e5f6a: feat(vault): integrate vault transit and pki flows for rotation orchestration
b7c8d9e: feat(helm): add preupgrade/postupgrade hooks to handle cert rollover and secrets rollout
c0d1e2f: feat(sealed-secrets): add sealedsecrets/templates and controller bootstrap script

review_comments: Ethan Park requested a clearer failure mode if Vault transit returns error during rotation; added retry/backoff and metrics (handled in rotate_kms_tls.sh)
Lena Hoffmann asked for a non-destructive dry-run; added --dry-run flag and e2e test for dry-run behavior
Carlos Mendez requested HSM integration docs and interface contract; added variables and example HSM config in terraform module
Author response: addressed comments, added unit tests for the rotation script and helm hooks, and updated docs with operational playbook
notes: This PR was tested against an internal Vault dev cluster and a hardware HSM emulator. Operators must set the 'rotation.enabled' flag and provide Vault address + role. Backwards compatible with existing installer when rotation.enabled=false. Rollback behavior documented in docs/operator/rotation.md. Follow-up: add KMS provider abstraction to allow AWS KMS and cloud HSM providers (ENG-3498).
